description: Déploiement fibre optique - Calendrier - Val de Loire Numérique - Département Loir-et-Cher is a dataset listed in data-grandchambord open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Val de Loire Numérique. Ce jeu de données présente le planning prévisionnel de première ouverture commerciale d'une plaque tel que présenté via le portail data du SMO Val de Loire Numérique à l'échelle du Département de Loir-et-Cher. Données: Une plaque est un secteur technique qui regroupe entre 300 à 400 foyers et entreprises. Coverage: Grand Chambord (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Économie/Europe. Its keywords are fibre, tres haut debit, ftth, THD. The portal shows 368 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-grandchambord-fr-portal.
